notes.title: The Interface Overhaul
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45263569/6e6037bddb96cf5ad6ae63d8ae0a409b5d33c61a.png

Greetings, Gamblers 💀

Check Out What’s New
Alongside a fresh UI update, you can now wager your bets against the AI! Your objective remains the same, but there’s a twist — manage the souls you save along the way. Will you sacrifice them for powerful buffs, or play it safe and hold onto your chances? The choice is yours… and it just might cost you.


Bugs/Fixes

 Fixed Pen and Holy Water to properly adjust values.

 Added visual highlights to show which dice values are being called after a bet.

 Added a limited-use feature to re-roll dice by pressing on them.

 UI Overhaul: Cleaner, sharper interface.

 Soul Bidding: Bid with souls.


Ways to Help
⭐ Leave a Steam Review – Every review helps more players discover the game!
📸 Share Your Moments – Show off your best plays and wildest strategies!
🎮 Join the Community – Connect with others and share your experiences!


Happy gambling, and may the dice be ever in your favor!

Version 1.4 .0 Patch Notes

notes.title: Liar's Dice - Patch Notes 03
notes.content:
Greetings, Gamblers!

Check out what’s new in the game:


 Enhanced UI Scaling
The user interface has been updated to be larger, offering better visibility and an improved gameplay experience.

 Faster Betting
The time it takes for players to make bets has been reduced, ensuring a smoother and faster pace for the action.

 Item Hover Descriptions
You can now hover over items to view detailed descriptions of their effects, making it easier to strategize and plan your moves.

 Dice Reveal on Lies
When a lie is called, both the player’s and the devil’s dice are now displayed, providing better clarity on who won the showdown.


Happy gambling, and may the dice be ever in your favor!
